scripts.build:site: rm -rf public & for f in pages/*.md; do n=$(basename "$f" .md); npm run build -- "$f" --base "/optimized-dl/$n/" --out "../public/$n" || exit 1; done && cp -R index.html images public/
scripts.preview:site: mkdir -p /tmp/optimized-dl-preview && ln -sfn "$PWD/public" /tmp/optimized-dl-preview/optimized-dl && echo 'Open http://localhost:3000/optimized-dl/' && npx serve /tmp/optimized-dl-preview --symlinks
scripts.site: npm run build:site && npm run preview:site
